europe_now.title: Russian Strikes Hit Kyiv Amid Diplomatic Moves
europe_now.summary: Russian missile strikes targeted Kyiv as diplomatic discussions regarding peace talks continued. The attacks occurred while various international figures commented on the trajectory of the conflict.

sources.headline: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks

europe_now.title: French Authorities Implement Security Bans Following Unrest
europe_now.summary: Cities across France, including Paris and Lyon, implemented bans on demonstrations following episodes of violent civil unrest. Meanwhile, French bond yields reached a 24-year high in the wake of the disturbances.

sources.headline: Live: Paris bans protests after violent unrest as Macron takes swipe at Trump
Live: Lyon bans 'all demonstrations' in France's third-largest city Saturday

top_stories.title: European Parliament Raids
top_stories.summary: European prosecutors searched the offices of the far-right Patriots for Europe group in Brussels and Strasbourg. The raids were conducted as part of an investigation into the alleged misuse of parliamentary funds.

sources.headline: EU prosecutors search European Parliament offices of far-right group
EU prosecutors raid far-right Patriots for Europe offices in Brussels and Strasbourg over alleged misuse of parliament funds

top_stories.title: Polish Abortion Legislation
top_stories.summary: The Polish parliament voted to liberalize the country's abortion laws. However, the proposed changes are expected to face a veto from the conservative president.

sources.headline: Polish parliament liberalises abortion law – but conservative president likely to veto changes

top_stories.title: Human Rights Recognition
top_stories.summary: The International Criminal Court was awarded the European Parliament's human rights prize. The recognition comes despite receiving prior sanctions from the United States.

sources.headline: Trump-sanctioned ICC wins EU Parliament’s human rights prize

top_stories.title: Irish Peacekeeping Referendum
top_stories.summary: Ireland held a vote regarding the requirement for UN approval on overseas peacekeeping missions. The decision aims to alter the regulatory framework for deploying Irish troops abroad.

sources.headline: Ireland votes to end UN approval requirement for overseas peacekeeping missions
